luci-app-isp-split.description: Grant access to ISP split status and control. WARNING: write = execute ANY isp-split subcommand as root (wire/apply/conf set/uninstall); grant only to fully trusted admins. read = conf + whole state tree (public IP/geo/STUN). wizard = one file write scope only (/etc/isp-split/state/wizard.json), no directory-wide write.
